verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is explicitly designed for natural-language operation (querying/editing codebases, debugging, automating tasks all via NL per gh-1/3/4/9), and one user praised its ability to navigate huge codebases via NL prompts (comm-1). However, multiple hands-on reports describe it getting stuck in error loops, ignoring instructions in GEMINI.md, jumping straight into buggy edits without a plan mode, and in one case a catastrophic natural-language-driven file deletion incident — concrete evidence that NL command operation is unreliable in practice (comm-10, comm-11, comm-13, comm-14, comm-16). Missing for 10: consistent independent verification that NL commands reliably execute complex agentic tasks without frequent failure loops or instruction-ignoring.
